In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the string theory on AdS 3 × SE 3 is a non-trivial theory, which is not equivalent to the string theory on T 1,3 × SE 1.
there is no such a thing as a “string loop correction” to the AdS/CFT correspondence, and all stringy effects are of order 1/λ, and hence are of order α ′3 in the AdS radius.
the AdS/CFT correspondence is a duality between two theories that have the same symmetries and are both non-perturbative in the string coupling constant.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 1/N2 corrections in N = 1 supersymmetric theories are given by the free hypermultiplet, whereas the 1/N corrections are determined by the free vector multiplet.
the closed string loop effects on c − a are the same as those of a single free N = 4 vector multiplet.

string loop corrections to the AdS/CFT correspondence are not only consistent with but in many cases provide an explanation for the appearance of free hypermultiplets in lower dimensional dual field theories.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the closed string loop corrections to the anomaly coefficients are universal, and are independent of the compactification manifold.

string loop corrections to the field theory anomaly coefficients are not necessarily related to the string loop correction of the gravitational effective action, which has been studied in detail in the literature.
